snippet.title: FERALPALS STEAM TRAILER
snippet.description:
HEY EVERYONE
In collaboration with the amazing game publisher Ytopia, I am thrilled to announce that FERALPALS is making its way to Steam!
An improved and enhanced and localized Chapter 01 is available to download and play for completely FREE today. Check out the new trailer, survive the first chapter, and please drop a Wishlist to support the launch!
🔗 Jump in here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4750100/FERALPALS/

so excited :D
#IndieDev #HorrorGaming #MascotHorror #PSXHorror
